jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Learning-Based Multi-Agent Control under Uncertainty
jobs.description:
The Department of Electronic Systems at the Technical Faculty of IT and Design invites applications for a postdoc in learning-based multi-agent control under uncertainty, with applications to autonomous multi-robot systems operating in dynamic and uncertain environments, as per February 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is available for a period of 2 years.

Your work tasks   The position focuses on fundamental research in learning-based planning and control of interacting autonomous agents under uncertainty. You will develop new theoretical and algorithmic approaches for distributed and cooperative control, combining learning or online adaptation with principled treatment of safety, robustness, and performance. Research challenges include uncertain dynamics and disturbances, partial or noisy information, changing interactions between agents, and limited or unreliable communication.

A central part of the work will be to formulate rigorous methods and establish their properties, for example concerning stability, safety, constraint satisfaction, robustness, and convergence, where applicable. Depending on the research direction, the work may draw on learning-augmented model predictive control, safe reinforcement learning, data-driven modelling and safety mechanism (e.g. CBF), distributed optimization, or robust and adaptive control. You will develop reproducible numerical studies and simulations to examine the strengths, limitations, and scalability of the proposed methods.

The research will be carried out in the Horizon Europe ROX-6G project, where heterogeneous robot teams provide a compelling application for coordination under uncertain conditions and connectivity constraints. Although the position is primarily theoretical, you will collaborate with colleagues working on robotic implementation and will contribute to experimental validation. You will lead and co-author publications in international journals and conferences, engage with project partners, contribute to research planning and scientific discussions, and support knowledge exchange within the team.

Your competencies

We seek a researcher with a PhD in control engineering, robotics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, or a closely related field, and a strong background in mathematical modelling, control, optimization, or multi-agent systems.

You should be able to formulate original research problems, develop and analyse rigorous methods, and demonstrate research quality through peer-reviewed scientific publications. Experience in learning-based control, robust or nonlinear control, distributed control, or decision-making under uncertainty is particularly relevant; expertise in every one of these areas is not expected.

You should have good scientific programming skills, for example in Python, MATLAB, or C++, and be able to evaluate algorithms systematically through simulation. We value independent research initiative, clear scientific writing, and the ability to work constructively with researchers from different disciplines and backgrounds. Experience with autonomous robots, ROS/ROS 2, multi-robot simulation, or physical robotic experiments will be considered an advantage, but is not a prerequisite for this primarily theory-oriented position. Excellent written and spoken English is required.

Who we are

In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 600 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

The position is hosted in the Automation and Control Section, within a collaborative robotics research environment combining fundamental research with real-world applications.

In addition, you will work with an international team and research partners in ROX-6G, a European collaboration addressing autonomous robotic operations in demanding underground environments. Our research interests span safe and resilient decision-making, learning-enabled control, distributed multi-robot coordination, and validation in simulation and on robotic platforms. We encourage scientific independence, close exchange of ideas, and publication of high-quality research. More information: www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply

Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)

• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications.

• Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.

• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc.

• Additional qualifications in relation to the position

• References/recommendations

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information

Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Postdoc”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.occupation: Senior CRM Analyst

jobs.occupation: Tax Manager - Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the tax function of an international shipping company?

Clipper is enhancing its internal tax capability as part of a continued focus on strengthening governance and decision support across the organisation. We are therefore looking for a dedicated and hands-on Tax Manager to be based at Clipper’s headquarters in Copenhagen.

Today, tax matters at Clipper are handled across Finance, Legal and external advisors. With increasing regulatory complexity and risk exposure, we are establishing a more formalized and proactive tax function. The Tax Manager will play a key role in building this capability and embedding robust tax governance across the organization.

You will report directly to the CFO and work closely with the Head of Legal & Corporate Affairs and Head of Controlling and external advisors.

What will be your responsibilities

You will be responsible for both strategic and operational tax matters across Clipper’s global activities. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

• Establish and maintain Clipper’s tax governance framework, including a tax risk register and clear processes for identifying, assessing and managing tax risks.

• Review the tax implications of material transactions and challenge tax positions and advice from external advisors where relevant.

• Own and oversee transfer pricing policies, intercompany agreements, benchmarking and documentation.

• Monitor and manage cross-border tax matters, including withholding tax, freight tax and permanent establishment risks.

• Oversee compliance with Danish tonnage tax requirements, including calculations, documentation and relevant controls.

• Coordinate corporate tax, VAT and employment tax compliance and reporting across jurisdictions, ensuring timely filings and robust documentation.

• Advise on tax matters related to international employee mobility and contractor arrangements.

• Monitor relevant tax and regulatory developments, including OECD Pillar Two and environmental and emissions-related taxes, and assess their impact on Clipper.

• Act as Clipper’s internal tax expert and trusted sparring partner, advising management on tax implications of strategic and operational decisions.

What we are looking for

At Clipper, our employees shape our work environment, so bringing a positive attitude is essential.

• We imagine that you have a relevant educational background within finance, tax, business administration, law or similar, combined with solid experience in corporate and international tax.

• You have hands-on experience with tax governance and tax risk management, combined with strong knowledge of transfer pricing, cross-border taxation and international tax principles.

• You are comfortable working with external advisors while also challenging and validating tax positions when needed.

• You are structured and analytical, but also pragmatic and commercially minded.

• You enjoy taking ownership, working independently and turning complex tax matters into practical advice and solutions for the business.

• You communicate confidently across functions and levels of the organisation and are fluent in both Danish and English.

• Shipping experience, including knowledge of tonnage tax or other shipping-specific tax matters, is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Don’t meet every single requirement?

If you’re enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the ideal candidate for this position, or for another opportunity with us.

What you will love about us

At Clipper, you will become part of a growing and professional work environment where we strive to be the best. We offer:

• A key role with significant influence on Clipper Bulk's tax framework and risk profile

• The opportunity to build and shape an internal tax function

• Close collaboration with senior management and exposure to strategic decision-making

• A welcoming and inclusive work environment with a variety of socal, sports, and cultural events throughout the year

• Attractive employee benefits, including pension, health, dental and critical ilness insurance

• Beautiful office facilities in Nordhavn, located near the metro with on-site paring, delicious lunch arangement and access to fitness facilities and a personal trainer.

Application and recruitment process

Please submit your CV and cover letter through our application portal by 22nd November 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be treated with full discretion.

The recruitment process consist of two interview rounds. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a first interview, while candidates progressing to the second round will be asked to complete a personality assessment beforehand. Confidential reference checks will be conducted for final candidates.

Learn more about Clipper at clipper-bulk.com, LinkedIn, and Instagram.

Clipper is an industry leader in dry bulk, an operator, a pool manager, and a specialist in steel services. We operate a modern fleet of approximately 120 handysize and supramax vessels, transporting a wide range of cargo from dry bulk to break bulk. Clipper is commercially headquartered in Copenhagen and employs a staff of around 100 onshore worldwide. We are a global workplace with firm values, where we welcome a growth mindset, curiosity, and ambition.

Sustainability initiatives - we strive to make a positive impact. As a maritime player with a global presence at sea and onshore, we recognize our social, environmental, and ethical responsibility. We push for positive development by responsibly running our business and promoting sustainable business behavior in our network. Read more about sustainability initiatives on our website.

jobs.occupation: CMF Industrial Designer - Crafting Meaning Through Colour, Material & Finish

Do you see colour, material, and finish as more than aesthetics, but as a way to create meaning, trust, and emotional connection? At Coloplast, we design products for people living with deeply personal medical conditions. As part of our Product Development team, you will help define how our products are perceived, experienced, and trusted in everyday use.

Our products are used daily by millions of people. This requires a thoughtful balance between brand expression, user needs, and manufacturing reality ensuring every CMF decision is both meaningful and feasible.

Your Role

As a CMF Designer, you will work across cross-functional teams from early concept through to production, typically across one to two projects at a time. You will translate user insights, brand principles, and product requirements into cohesive CMF directions, balancing aesthetics, usability, and manufacturability. Working closely with industrial designers, engineers, and suppliers, you will ensure CMF intent is realized with quality and consistency.

You will contribute to defining CMF frameworks, palettes, and material strategies, while collaborating across disciplines to ensure alignment and a coherent product expression. At times, you will actively manage stakeholders to align on vision and design direction, ensuring CMF decisions support both design intent and broader product objectives.

You will be surrounded by passionate colleagues who continuously refine and evolve our design language, grounded in our mission to create products that restore dignity and empower users.

Key Responsibilities

•   Develop CMF concepts from early exploration through to production

•   Translate insights and briefs into actionable CMF directions

•   Define colors, materials, and finishes aligned with brand and product intent

•   Support creation of CMF boards, renderings, and physical samples

•   Specify CMF for production (colour targets, finish callouts, durability requirements)

•   Collaborate with engineering and suppliers to ensure feasibility and quality

•   Support communication of CMF intent across teams and stakeholders

•   Support material selection with consideration for cost, performance, and sustainability

•   Research materials, finishes, and processes to identify new opportunities

•   Contribute to innovation in sustainable and high-quality CMF solutions

Experience

•   3-5 years of experience in CMF, Industrial Design, or related fields

•   Degree in Industrial Design, CMF, Textile Design, or similar

•   Portfolio demonstrating strong CMF thinking and product applications

•   Strong understanding of colour theory, various materials, and finishes

•   Experience with manufacturing processes (e.g., injection moulding, coatings, printing)

•   Ability to create CMF specifications for production

•   Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and visualization tools (e.g., KeyShot, Vizcom)

•   Fluency in English

Mindset

•   Strong aesthetic sensitivity and attention to detail

•   Ability to translate trends and insights into clear design directions

•   Confident communicator with the ability to explain design rationale

•   Collaborative, curious, and quality-driven

•   Passionate about user-centered design and meaningful product experiences

Why Join Us

At Coloplast, CMF is not just about appearance, it’s about trust, comfort, and dignity. You will help shape products that people rely on every day, in a collaborative and purpose-driven environment.

Interested?

If your qualifications match the description and you’re ready to take your career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you.

Please submit your application, including a link to your portfolio.

If you wish to forward your portfolio as a file instead of providing a link, please contact Ignacio D'Avola at dkigda@coloplast.com.

Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. This position will remain open until a suitable candidate has been found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

jobs.occupation: Data Portfolio Analyst, Markets Data Office
jobs.description:
Recently graduated or one to two years into your career? Join us and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now.

Join us in building a new data capability in Markets

About the job

At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets.

We are a newly established team and still in our build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve.

As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets.

This is an opportunity to join early, learn quickly and help shape how we work.

What you will do

As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will work within one of our four domain areas together with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams. Your focus will be on improving how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled.

Depending on your domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market data, price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data.

You will learn about Markets from experienced colleagues and gradually take responsibility for your own tasks. At the same time, you will be part of one Markets Data Office with shared standards, tooling and governance practices.

Your responsibilities will include

• Helping identify and document Critical Data Attributes (CDAs) by reviewing data points with stakeholders and assessing which are critical for Saxo

• Analysing data together with data owners to assess quality, identify issues and contribute to root cause investigations

• Helping define and maintain data definitions, rules, thresholds and supporting documentation

• Monitoring data quality outputs, following up on remediation and raising issues when they are not being resolved

• Collaborating with data owners, data stewards and stakeholders across business and technology

• Contributing to the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office

A key part of your role will be making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain. This helps create transparency and consistency across the organisation.

Who you are

You have recently graduated or have around one to two years of professional experience.

We imagine that you bring:

• A relevant degree in finance, economics, business analytics, information systems, data science or a similar field

• An interest in data and how it is used in business processes

• Experience with SQL, Python or similar tools from your studies, a student job or projects

• Hands on experience using AI and other technology tools to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working

• Good communication skills in English and the ability to write clear and structured documentation

It would be an advantage if you have

• Experience from banking or financial services, for example through a student job

• Knowledge of, or an interest in, Markets functions such as trading, risk, investment products or operations, including how a trade moves from front to back

• Exposure to data governance or data quality work such as data profiling, data controls or data lineage, ideally within financial services

• Familiarity with Databricks, Great Expectations, OpenMetadata or similar tools

Just as important as your experience is how you approach your work.

We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership. You move your work forward, follow through and take initiative.

• Collaborates naturally. You build relationships with business stakeholders, technology teams and colleagues across different domain areas.

• Uses technology naturally. You use technology to analyse, automate, document and find more effective ways of working.

• Is comfortable working in an evolving environment. You adapt as priorities develop, bring structure to areas that are still taking shape and contribute to building solutions together with the team.

• Is structured and curious. You have a strong analytical mindset, pay attention to detail and enjoy understanding how things work.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters most is your curiosity, initiative and willingness to learn.

What we offer

• The opportunity to help build a new data function from the ground up

• A steep learning curve across Markets, critical data and data governance, supported by experienced colleagues

• Hands on guidance, regular feedback and an introduction to both your Markets domain and our governance practices

• Real responsibility from the beginning, with the opportunity to take on more as you develop

You will join the Markets Data Office at an early stage of its journey, so your role will develop alongside the team. You can expect new challenges, increasing responsibility and the opportunity to influence how critical data is managed across Markets.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

jobs.occupation: Development Manager
jobs.description:
IST is looking for an experienced Development Manager who thrives at the intersection of technology, people, and delivery and who is ready to lead and evolve our development organization to the next level.

At IST, we’re not just building software—we’re shaping the future of education. Our digital tools connect schools, teachers, students, and families in smarter, more meaningful ways. With over five million users across Europe, our mission is clear: to make learning easier, more engaging, and more impactful for everyone.

Joining IST means working in an international, collaborative environment where your leadership and ideas make a real difference. You’ll guide and inspire development teams, influence technical direction, and contribute to products used by thousands of schools—while growing alongside experienced colleagues who are passionate about improving education.

Role overview

We are looking for a Development Manager who is passionate about people, software development and building high-performing engineering teams. In this role, you will lead and support a few development teams while working closely with Product Owners, Architects and other stakeholders to create high-quality software solutions.

As a Development Manager, your primary focus will be leadership, team development, delivery and creating an environment where engineers can thrive and do their best work. We also believe you are curious about emerging technologies and interested in how AI can support software development, collaboration and innovation.

Key responsibilities

• Lead, coach and support some development teams

• Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing engineering culture

• Support team members in their professional growth and development

• Ensure effective ways of working, agile processes and continuous improvement

• Collaborate with Product Owners and other stakeholders to align priorities and deliveries

• Drive recruitment, onboarding and team development activities

• Help teams remove obstacles and improve delivery capabilities

• Follow up on team goals, performance, engagement and work environment

• Encourage experimentation and learning around new technologies, including AI-driven tools and workflows

Role qualifications

We believe you have the following experience, capabilities and personal skills to succeed in this role:

• A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or related field

• Previous experience in a leadership role within software development

• A background in software engineering or technical product development

jobs.occupation: Fulfilment Operations Co-worker, 20 timer pr. uge, Aalborg
jobs.description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

Candidate profile (text) - Default language Are you fascinated by the beauty of logistics? Would you like to work in an environment where things are done professionally? Can we rely on you even in the early hours of the day? If so, you are a good match as a logistic co-worker for our store.

Key responsibilities (title) A day in your life with us

Key responsibilities (text) In IKEA Logistics, we are responsible not just for receiving goods each day, but unloading the trucks, replenishing them in the store using forklifts, powered stackers and pallet lifters, ensuring that IKEA is ready by 10AM sharp when the store opens. As a logistics co-worker in our self-service warehouse, you play an important role in IKEA's sales figures and customers, as the department makes sure that customers never go in vain when it comes to buying furniture for their home. Everyday life is always busy, as we work with a sharp deadline.

In addition, we expect that you:

• Are in good physical shape and can handle manual labor

• Thrive by working during the early hours of the day

• Can prioritize and organize your own and the teams work to make efficient use of time

• Are able to communicate in English and enthusiastic about working in a team

• Have a Danish forklift license - or willing to acquire one.

Your tasks will be:

• Loading goods into the warehouse by driving reach truck and powered stacker

• Working together and following up with colleagues to keep the store fully stocked

• Goods receiving and handling, as well as updating IT systems accordingly

• Proactively securing the safety of your colleagues and our customers in your working area

• Goods replenishment for our customers

• Clean up and maintaining the department and machines.

Team vision ( title) Our team within IKEA

Team vision (text) You can become part of an international team of both fulltime and part-time employees that work towards a common goal. We secure an efficient replenishment of the store and provide good customer service, even though we do not have direct customer contact. We work closely together with all departments, and consequently gain experience in collaborating with many different types of people. We work in a fast-paced environment, but always support each other and work as a team. Therefore, there is room for you to be exactly who you are. We will ensure all necessary and correct trainings, so you will feel safe and competent in the job. At IKEA you have endless possibilities to grow!

Let's connect Questions and support? Let's connect!

Let´s connect If you have any questions please contact our Logistics Team Leader, Artúr Hajdu (artur.hajdu@inkga.ikea.com) Please note that we only accept applications via our recruitment system and not by email.

Local section (title) Further information

Local section (text) • This position is for an average of 20 hours per week

• Working hours between 04:00 to 12:00. You should expect to work every third weekend. It is possible to give your input for the work schedule

• Salary is within IKEAs banding for logistics and includes pension- and free choice allowance and odd hour payment

• Other employment terms follow HKs Funktionæroverenskomst

• We have various staff benefits including private health insurance, massage, Cantine, staff discount, discount club with external partners, yearly gift, bonus etc.

• During the recruitment process, we reserve the right to ask for a criminal record

• Start date is as early as possible

• We have an ongoing interview process and reserve the right to close the job when we have received enough qualified candidates.

Like homes, talent is also diverse, and in IKEA we have a passion for real people. When applying for jobs, some are discouraged if they do not meet every single competence area, but please feel free to still apply. We would love to get to know you as there is a wide range of opportunities in IKEA, based on desire, ability, and experience. We hope you will join us on this adventure, and we are looking forward to hearing from you!

Why you will love us

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

What we all have in common

• Living our values

• Being your unique self, while respecting and including others

• A passion for home furnishing

• Performing & delivering while learning & developing

• Having fun!

jobs.occupation: Project lead (strain engineering for client delivery)
jobs.description:
Enduro Genetics is a world-leading biotech at the interface of synthetic biology and biomanufacturing. Our platform product Enduro Sense is a transformative gene technology that redefines the capabilities of cells in fermentation. Enduro Sense is used for cell-based expression systems and production strains to deliver higher titer, rate and yields, making biomanufacturing more efficient and scalable.

As we expand to meet growing client demands, we are seeking a results-driven and people-oriented Project Lead to oversee our microbial strain engineering projects with clients.

Who You Are:

This role is perfect for a senior science leader passionate about leveraging synthetic biology to create tangible biomanfacturing step-ups for clients while fostering team growth and motivation. You thrive in fast-paced settings, communicate clearly and are eager to join a rapidly scaling company, currently around 25 employees.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and mentor high-performing R&D teams to drive project success.

• Develop and implement research strategies to meet key milestones.

• Oversee client projects to ensure timely progress and impactful results.

• Collaborate with scientists and stakeholders of all levels to deliver on project timelines and deliverables.

• Provide expert technical guidance to support project outcomes.

What You Bring:

• Education: PhD in Synthetic Biology, Molecular Biology, or a related discipline.

• Industry Experience: 7+ years in microbial strain engineering, with corporate expertise in pharmaceutical or industrial bioprocesses.

• Technical Expertise:

• Strong background in production strain technology, recombinant protein expression, or metabolite production.

• Proven track-record in developing microbial strains for bioprocesses.

• Leadership: Exceptional project management skills, including team mentorship and development.

• Analytical and Communication: Ability to solve complex problems and communicate effectively incl. in written and oral presentations.

• Adaptability: Capacity to excel in a dynamic, fast-growing organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience leading agile R&D teams.

• Technical strain engineering experience in Bacillus, E. coli, Corynebacterium or yeasts (Pichia, S. cerevisiae etc)

• Familiarity with corporate bioprocess development workflows.

• Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DoE), small-scale automation, and fermentation science.

• Background in pharmaceutical GMP environments.

• Relevant experience from e.g. a CDMO or CRO on delivering projects with clients or collaboration partners

Why Join Enduro Genetics?

At Enduro, you'll play a vital role roling out our technology to leading clients, shaping the future of biomanufacturing. Be part of a collaborative and innovative environment where your contributions make a difference.

If you're ready to advance your career in industrial biotechnology and lead impactful projects, apply now to join our team.

Applications will be screened regularly

About Us

At Bagel Bites, good food and good service go hand in hand. Following a small restructuring of our management team, we are now looking for someone who can take responsibility for the day-to-day delegation of tasks and administration.

Responsibilities

As Restaurant Manager, you will play a key role in the daily operation of the restaurant. Your primary responsibilities will include:

• 
Developing the company’s overall marketing strategy.

• 
Supervising restaurant employees, effectively delegating tasks, and handling customer matters.

• 
Potentially managing the company’s social media accounts.

• 
Contributing to financial administration, including budgeting, reporting, and accounting.

Qualifications

We are looking for a qualified candidate with the following skills and competencies:

• 
Relevant education or experience in management, preferably within the restaurant or service industry.

• 
Communication skills to develop effective marketing messages.

Application

If you believe your experience and skills match our requirements, we encourage you to send your application and CV to info@sundsult.dk or rkbgaps@gmail.com, with the subject line: “Application Manager.”

Hos Bagel Bites går god mad og god service hånd i hånd, og efter en lille omrokering af vores ledelse søger vi nu en person, som kan stå for den daglige uddelegering af opgaver og administration.

Opsyn med restaurantens ansatte, effektiv uddelegering af arbejdsopgaver samt kundehåndtering.

Relevant uddannelse eller erfaring inden for ledelse, gerne inden for restaurant- eller servicebranchen.

Kommunikationsevner til at udforme effektive markedsføringsbudskaber.
